mapper.select: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', now())::date AS cm, (date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month')::date AS pm ), rev AS ( SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(r.revenue,0) FROM v_revenue_monthly r, bounds b WHERE r.month = b.cm) AS cur, (SELECT COALESCE(r.revenue,0) FROM v_revenue_monthly r, bounds b WHERE r.month = b.pm) AS prev ), ord AS ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o, bounds b WHERE o.status != 'canceled' AND date_trunc('month', o.ordered_at)::date = b.cm) AS cur, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o, bounds b WHERE o.status != 'canceled' AND date_trunc('month', o.ordered_at)::date = b.pm) AS prev ) SELECT rev.cur::bigint AS month_revenue, ROUND((rev.cur - rev.prev)::numeric / NULLIF(rev.prev,0) * 100, 1) AS revenue_delta_pct, ord.cur::bigint AS orders_count, ROUND((ord.cur - ord.prev)::numeric / NULLIF(ord.prev,0) * 100, 1) AS orders_delta_pct, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c, bounds b WHERE date_trunc('month', c.created_at)::date = b.cm)::bigint AS new_customers, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.total)) FROM sales_order o, bounds b WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND date_trunc('month', o.delivered_at)::date = b.cm),0)::bigint AS avg_order FROM rev, ord

SELECT to_char(delivered_at,'MM-DD') AS label, SUM(total)::bigint AS amount FROM sales_order WHERE status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at >= current_date - make_interval(days => (#{days} - 1)) GROUP BY delivered_at ORDER BY delivered_at

SELECT o.id, o.code, o.customer_name, o.phone, o.total, o.status, o.ordered_at, o.delivered_at, o.source, (SELECT string_agg(i.product_name || ' ×' || i.qty, ', ') FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) AS items_summary FROM sales_order o ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, sku, name, brand, category_id, price, pack, stock, status FROM product WHERE status IN ('low','out') ORDER BY stock ASC, id LIMIT #{limit}
